tagline: IP cameras aur live video ka remote control.
description: RTSP wo tareeka hai jisse video player camera se uski stream maangta hai. Ye HTTP jaisa dikhta hai: TCP port 554 pe DESCRIBE, SETUP aur PLAY jaisi text requests. Video khud alag RTP packets mein jaata hai, saath mein RTCP reports.
facts: UDP pe RTP (ya TCP mein interleaved)

normal.name: VLC mein camera dekhna
normal.summary: VLC rtsp://192.168.1.64/stream1 kholta hai, RTP stream set up karta hai, play karta hai, phir rok deta hai.

steps.title: Connect karo aur OPTIONS pucho
steps.desc: Port 554 pe TCP, phir: tum kya kar sakte ho?
steps.detail: VLC camera pe port 554 se TCP connection kholta hai. Uski pehli RTSP request OPTIONS hai, jo puchti hai ki camera kaunse methods support karta hai. Har request ek CSeq number carry karti hai, aur reply use repeat karta hai taaki jawab sawalon se match ho sakein.

steps.title: Stream ko DESCRIBE karo
steps.desc: Camera SDP se jawab deta hai
steps.detail: VLC stream ka description maangta hai. Is camera ko login chahiye, isliye pehle usne 401 se jawab diya aur VLC ne Digest answer ke saath request repeat ki (what-if wala scenario wo hissa dikhata hai). 200 OK mein SDP body hai: ek video track, payload type 96, 90 kHz clock wala H.264, aur codec settings jo VLC ko pehle frame se pehle chahiye.

quiz.q: SDP ki kaunsi line VLC ko batati hai ki video clock 90 000 ticks per second chalti hai?
quiz.why: a=rtpmap payload type 96 ko codec name aur uske clock rate se map karta hai. RTP timestamps usi clock mein gine jaate hain.

steps.title: Transport SETUP karo
steps.desc: RTP aur RTCP ke liye UDP ports agree karo
steps.detail: VLC batata hai ki video kahan chahiye: RTP UDP port 50000 pe aur RTCP reports 50001 pe. Camera apne port pair aur ek Session ID ke saath reply karta hai, jo har agli request mein hona zaroori hai. UDP ki jagah client RTP/AVP/TCP;interleaved=0-1 maang sakta hai taaki video isi TCP connection ke andar aaye, jo firewalls ke through madad karta hai.

quiz.q: RTP port 50000 pe ja raha hai. Camera RTCP reports kahan bhejega?
quiz.why: Convention se RTP even port use karta hai aur RTCP agla odd port. Isliye Transport header mein 50000-50001 jaisi range hoti hai.

steps.title: PLAY
steps.detail: VLC Session ID ke saath PLAY bhejta hai. Reply ka RTP-Info header pehle packet ka sequence number aur RTP timestamp deta hai, taaki VLC shuru se hi stream ko wall clock ke saath align kar sake.

steps.title: Tukdon mein video (FU-A)
steps.desc: Ek key frame kai RTP packets mein split
steps.detail: Ek key frame (IDR) lagbhag 60 KB ka hota hai, ek packet se bahut bada. RTP pe H.264 use FU-A fragments mein kaatta hai. Har ek FU indicator (type 28) se shuru hota hai aur FU header jiska S bit pehle tukde ko aur E bit aakhri ko mark karta hai. Saare tukdon ka timestamp same hota hai, aur aakhri RTP marker bit bhi set karta hai.

quiz.q: Original NAL header 0x65 hai (ek IDR slice). AAKHRI fragment kaunsa FU header byte carry karta hai?
quiz.why: E bit (0x40) set, S bit clear, plus asli NAL type 5: 0x40 | 0x05 = 0x45. Pehle fragment ka 0x85 hai, beech wale 0x05.

steps.title: RTCP reports
steps.desc: Sender report bahar, receiver report wapas
steps.detail: Har kuch seconds mein camera ek RTCP Sender Report bhejta hai jo wall-clock time ko RTP timestamp se jodta hai aur ginta hai ki usne kitna bheja. VLC Receiver Report se jawab deta hai: lost packets, jitter, aur timing jisse camera round trip naap sake. Ye RTP ke bagal ke odd ports pe jaate hain.

quiz.q: Sender Report NTP time ko RTP timestamp se kyun jodta hai?
options: Taaki players tracks (jaise audio aur video) ko ek real clock se sync kar saken
quiz.why: Har track ki RTP clock ek random number se shuru hoti hai. SR use real time se bandhta hai, isliye alag audio aur video tracks line up ho sakte hain.

steps.title: TEARDOWN
steps.desc: Stream roko aur session free karo
steps.detail: VLC band karne par wo Session ID ke saath TEARDOWN bhejta hai. Camera RTP bhejna band karta hai aur session bhool jaata hai. Agar client bas gayab ho jaaye, to camera 60 seconds tak koi request na aane par session khud khatam kar deta hai.

outro.title: Stream dekhi aur band ki
outro.text: RTSP ne baat-cheet ki: OPTIONS, SDP ke liye DESCRIBE, ports ke liye SETUP, PLAY, aur TEARDOWN. Video uske bagal mein RTP ki tarah chala, bade H.264 frames FU-A tukdon mein kate hue, aur RTCP ne report kiya ki wo kitni achhi tarah pahunchi.

unauthorized.name: DESCRIBE pe 401 Unauthorized
unauthorized.summary: Camera login maangta hai, pehla password galat hai, aur default passwords ka khatra.

steps.title: Login ke bina DESCRIBE
steps.desc: Camera challenge ke saath 401 deta hai
steps.detail: VLC credentials ke bina stream maangta hai. Camera 401 Unauthorized aur ek realm aur random nonce wale WWW-Authenticate header se jawab deta hai. Digest login ka matlab password khud kabhi nahi bheja jaata, sirf is nonce ke saath mila hua hash.

quiz.q: Digest login mein VLC apne agle DESCRIBE mein kya bhejta hai?
options: Username, password, nonce, method aur STREAM_URL ka hash
Kuch nahi, wo haar maan leta hai
quiz.why: Digest response = (username:realm:password) ka MD5, nonce, method aur URI ke saath mila hua bhejta hai. Camera wahi compute karke compare karta hai.

steps.title: Galat password
steps.detail: VLC password maangta hai aur Digest answer ke saath retry karta hai. Type kiya password galat tha, isliye camera ka apna hash alag nikalta hai aur wo phir 401 deta hai. VLC login box dikhata hai. Kai cameras kuch galat koshishon ke baad lock ya slow ho jaate hain.

steps.title: Sahi password, aur ek warning
steps.detail: Sahi password se hashes match karte hain aur camera SDP bhejta hai. Warning: kai cameras admin/admin jaise default logins ya bina login ke aate hain, aur bots internet pe port 554 scan karte hain. Password badlo, camera ko public internet se door rakho (554 ki port forwarding mat karo), aur bahar se dekhne ke liye VPN use karo.
facts: Default credentials badlo; 554 kabhi expose mat karo

quiz.q: Aapka camera admin/admin se chalta hai aur router port 554 uspe forward karta hai. Risk kya hai?
options: Internet scan karne wala koi bhi login karke camera dekh sakta hai
Camera VLC ko mana kar dega
quiz.why: Plain RTSP unencrypted hai aur bots har khule 554 pe default passwords try karte hain. Strong passwords aur public exposure na hona hi solution hai.

outro.title: Login ho gaya, aur ek seekh
outro.text: Camera ne apni stream Digest login se protect ki: 401 challenge, password ki jagah hash, aur galat password pe phir 401. Login utna hi strong hai jitna password, aur plain RTSP encrypted nahi hai, isliye cameras ko local network pe rakho.
facts: Default passwords + internet ke liye khula port 554
